parts.name: Root
parts.description: Contains all of the items. It holds the selection state and controls the roving focus.

props.name: value
props.description:
The list of the values of the open items. By default it goes in the two directions: use
`bind:value`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The values of the items that are open at the start, for when you give no `value`.

props.name: controlledValue
props.description:
Give your own code full control of the state. The component stops to write back to `value`, and
it reports only through `onChange`. Thus the parent can refuse a change: the parent does not
send the new value down. The default is off, because `bind:value` is the usual case and it
needs the write-back.

props.name: onChange
props.description:
The component calls it with the new list of the open item values, after the user opens or
closes a panel.

props.name: selectionMode
props.description:
The number of panels that can be open together: one with `'single'`, or more than one with
`'multiple'`.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables every item in the accordion.

props.name: orientation
props.description: The axis of the arrow keys between the triggers.

props.name: disallowEmptySelection
props.description: Keeps one panel open at all times.

props.name: loop
props.description: At the first trigger and at the last trigger, the focus goes to the opposite end.

props.name: id
props.description: The id of the root element. If you give none, the component makes one.

props.name: element
props.description: A bindable reference to the root element.

props.name: context
props.description: An accordion context that your own code makes, for a complex composition.

dataAttributes.name: data-accordion-root
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the root element.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-orientation
dataAttributes.description: The accordion orientation: 'vertical' or 'horizontal'.

parts.name: Item
parts.description: Contains one section that opens and closes. It gives its value to Header, Trigger and Panel through the context.

props.name: value
props.description: The unique value of the item. The Header, the Trigger, and the Panel read it from the context.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables this item only.

props.name: element
props.description: A bindable reference to the item element.

dataAttributes.name: data-accordion-item
dataAttributes.description: Identifies an item element.

dataAttributes.name: data-accordion-value
dataAttributes.description: The item value, serialized as a string.

dataAttributes.name: data-accordion-value-type
dataAttributes.description: The runtime type of the item value (string or number).

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-open
dataAttributes.description: Present while the item is expanded.

dataAttributes.name: data-orientation
dataAttributes.description: The accordion orientation: 'vertical' or 'horizontal'.

parts.name: Header
parts.description: A true heading element that contains the trigger. The default is h3.

props.name: level
props.description: The heading level of the element, to agree with the headings around it.

props.name: element
props.description: A bindable reference to the heading element.

dataAttributes.name: data-accordion-header
dataAttributes.description: Identifies a header element.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-open
dataAttributes.description: Present while the item is expanded.

parts.name: Trigger
parts.description: The button that opens and closes its panel. It sets aria-expanded and aria-controls.

props.name: element
props.description: A bindable reference to the trigger button.

dataAttributes.name: data-accordion-trigger
dataAttributes.description: Identifies a trigger element.

dataAttributes.name: data-accordion-value
dataAttributes.description: The item value, serialized as a string.

dataAttributes.name: data-accordion-value-type
dataAttributes.description: The runtime type of the item value (string or number).

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-visible
dataAttributes.description: Present while the focus must be visible (keyboard modality).

dataAttributes.name: data-focused
dataAttributes.description: Present while the element has focus.

dataAttributes.name: data-open
dataAttributes.description: Present while the item is expanded.

dataAttributes.name: data-orientation
dataAttributes.description: The accordion orientation: 'vertical' or 'horizontal'.

parts.name: Panel
parts.description: The region that opens and closes. While it is closed, it is hidden and inert.

props.name: forceMount
props.description:
Keep the closed panel in the DOM, and hidden. Without it, the panel leaves the DOM after the
exit animation.

props.name: region
props.description:
Makes the panel a `role="region"` landmark. The default is `true`. In an accordion with many
items, set it to `false`. Above approximately six panels, the APG recommends no `region`,
because too many landmarks make the landmark list difficult to use.

props.name: element
props.description: A bindable reference to the panel element.

dataAttributes.name: data-accordion-panel
dataAttributes.description: Identifies a panel element.

dataAttributes.name: data-accordion-panel-content
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the inner content element for the height animation.

dataAttributes.name: data-accordion-value
dataAttributes.description: The item value, serialized as a string.

dataAttributes.name: data-accordion-value-type
dataAttributes.description: The runtime type of the item value (string or number).

dataAttributes.name: data-closed
dataAttributes.description: Present while the item is collapsed.

dataAttributes.name: data-ending-style
dataAttributes.description: Present while the panel closes, for the CSS exit transition.

dataAttributes.name: data-open
dataAttributes.description: Present while the item is expanded.

dataAttributes.name: data-orientation
dataAttributes.description: The accordion orientation: 'vertical' or 'horizontal'.

dataAttributes.name: data-starting-style
dataAttributes.description: Present for one frame when the panel starts to open, for the CSS transition.
